scenarios.title: English · Covert pizza order distress call (demo video.mp3)
scenarios.description: Caller contacts Police Control Room pretending to order a pepperoni pizza because an aggressor is in the room. The dispatcher detects the anomaly, verifies covert distress, extracts floor-level apartment location, and initiates priority response.
scenarios.consent_note: Consented emergency call demonstration recording provided as demo video.mp3.

scenarios.title: Hinglish · distress + digital-arrest scam indicators
scenarios.description: Synthetic caller reports fear near Dadar station, a customs parcel story, a digital-arrest claim and a payment demand. A second quieter voice is mixed in. Designed to exercise ASR, translation, speaker clustering, reference matching and landmark mapping.
scenarios.consent_note: Synthetic demonstration audio generated with edge-tts. No real person, call or emergency is represented.

scenarios.title: English · help request near Marine Drive
scenarios.description: A short synthetic English call used to verify the English path without translation. It includes a spoken landmark and a request for help.
scenarios.consent_note: Synthetic demonstration audio generated with edge-tts. No real person, call or emergency is represented.
